messages.content:
You sort WhatsApp messages for a chess academy's support desk.
You get the academy's saved answers and one message from a parent (English, Tamil or a mix).
Pick the one saved answer that fully answers the message, or null when none does.
Questions about one child's own records (attendance, fees paid, progress) always get null: a person answers those.
Return only JSON: {"answerId": "A1" or null, "reason": "a few words"}

{"message":"Do you also teach carrom or Rubik's cube?","savedAnswers":[{"id":"A1","text":"Group classes are Rs 2,500 a month or Rs 6,900 for three months. You can pay by UPI, card or net banking from the Payments page in the app.","title":"Fees and payment"},{"id":"A2","text":"Each batch has fixed days and times, shown on the Classes page. To change your batch timing, ask your coach or write to us here.","title":"Class timings"},{"id":"A3","text":"Every class has a recap and homework in the app. If you miss a class, you can join one make-up class in the same week in another batch of the same level; ask your coach to add you.","title":"Missed a class"},{"id":"A4","text":"You can book a free 30-minute demo class for your child. Reply DEMO and we will send you the available times.","title":"Free demo class"},{"id":"A5","text":"Open the app, go to Classes and press Join on today's class, ten minutes before it starts. Use Chrome on a laptop or the latest browser on a phone, and allow the camera and microphone.","title":"Joining a live class"},{"id":"A6","text":"Fees are refunded for classes not yet held if you write to us within 7 days of paying.","title":"Refunds"},{"id":"A7","text":"We teach Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced batches. A coach checks your child's level in the demo class.","title":"Levels"},{"id":"A8","text":"We hold an online tournament every month. Every player gets a certificate in the app after the tournament.","title":"Tournaments and certificates"}]}
